move: line draws, bends into hexagon, grid spokes draw, data blooms, folds back
how: On a dark frame a white stroke draws itself left to right (drawSVG 0 to 100%, 1.2s expo.inOut at 0.02D), then morphSVGs into the outer hexagon over 1.4s (power3.inOut). Six spokes and two inner rings draw from the centre with staggered drawSVG (expo.out / expo.inOut), labels fade in, then two data polygons morph from a collapsed centre point to their values with back.out(1.4/1.6), dots scale in with back.out(3), and a score counts 0 to 76 (power2.out). At 0.66D the primary polygon re-flows to a second dataset with elastic.out(1,0.6) and the score runs to 84. From 0.84D everything collapses: dots, polygons to zero, grid drawSVG back to 0, copy leaves upward, and the hexagon morphs back to the line which erases (drawSVG 100% 100%).
adapt: Change the six axis labels, the A1/A2/B value arrays, colours and the side copy; keep the draw 1.2s, morph 1.4s, bloom back.out and the 8.4s fold-back that closes the loop.
port: mount(el, shot) injects the SVG and .side copy and builds the dot circles from the data; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with beats as fractions (0.02, 0.17, 0.3, 0.41, 0.66, 0.84 of D). Scope all id selectors to el and the score onUpdate to el.querySelector('#num').
caveats: gsap.set drawSVG 0% on rings and spokes must run in mount before the timeline
needs both MorphSVG and DrawSVG plugins
